name: MJ36 RGB LED Ring Light 36cm with 16 Colors, Brightness Control & Phone Holder
description:
Elevate your photos, videos, and livestreams with the MJ36 RGB LED Ring Light. Featuring a 36cm (13) soft glow design, it offers 16 RGB colors, 10 brightness levels, and full dimming control to suit every mood or setting. With dual color temperature options and high-quality LEDs, it ensures flawless lighting for content creators, makeup lovers, and professionals alike. Complete with a USB-powered setup and phone holder, it’s portable, versatile, and easy to use anywhere.
Key Features
 16 RGB colors + 10 brightness levels for endless effects
 Dual color temperature (3200K–6500K) for warm or cool tones
 High-quality 2835 LED beads with Ra>82 for true-to-life light
 USB-powered design for plug-and-play convenience
 Center phone holder for perfect framing
 Lightweight 36cm build with durable ABS + acrylic material
Ingredients / Materials
ABS plastic, acrylic, 2835 LED lamp beads, electronic components
How to Use
 Connect the ring light to a USB power source
 Adjust brightness, color, and temperature via the control switch
 Place your phone in the holder and set your preferred angle
 Use for photography, videos, streaming, or beauty routines
Package Includes
 1 × MJ36 RGB Ring Light (36cm)
 1 × Phone Holder
 1 × USB Power Cable
